steps.text: This video has a local narrator: the Kokoro model runs entirely on this computer, with no external services, and the voice you are hearing was generated in English.
Now we fill in the sign-up form. Actions keep going while I speak: only the next sentence waits for this one to finish, so the narration is never interrupted.
Email typed. Notice that the pointer really presses the buttons: every click draws a ring and concentric waves, like stones on still water.
Perfect: registration complete. The text read aloud always matches the exact moment it appears on screen.
